verdict.rationale: Graphite installs as an org-level GitHub App and lets admins turn on AI reviews for selected repositories. It also supports custom rules and comment exclusions for Graphite Agent, which together give some central control over review behavior. However, nothing documents org-wide review defaults that cascade to hundreds of repos, or a central way to manage per-repo exceptions, and the one org-wide control described (disabling AI) requires emailing support. Missing for 10: org-level review policy defaults inherited across repos, centralized per-repo exception/override management, evidence of operating at hundreds-of-repo scale, and independent corroboration.
